description: The RouterOS console menus mikroview drives, and the properties it sets on each. Only what mikroview uses -- not a copy of MikroTik's reference, and not their whole command list. scripts/routerosreference checks every path here still exists in MikroTik's published CLI Reference.

menus.usedFor: step 1 -- pulling mikroview's CA certificate onto the router; the push step's POST to /api/ingest/routeros; #1360's blocklist loaders fetching each list from its source
menus.verified: parsed on CHR 7.23.3 and 7.24.2, 2026-09-04. The fetch itself fails in the exercise because the address is a placeholder with nothing listening; that is a runtime failure, not a syntax one. http-method, http-data and http-header-field are the push's POST; that line is unchanged by #1360 and was not re-run against a live mikroview for it. #1360's loaders ran it against the seven lists' own sources on CHR 7.18.2 (with http-max-redirect-count=2), 7.22.3 and 7.24.4 (with check-certificate=yes against the built-in root store), 2026-10-01 (docs/routeros-verification-logs/<version>-blocklist.log).

menus.usedFor: step 1 -- trusting the certificate fetched above
menus.verified: parsed on CHR 7.23.3 and 7.24.2, 2026-09-04. Reports 'input does not match any value of file-name' in the exercise because the fetch before it could not land the file.

menus.usedFor: step 2 -- defining the remote syslog target that points at mikroview
step 2 -- sending firewall topics to that target
step 3 -- tagging existing rules so mikroview can decode the action from the log prefix
menus.verified: exercised on CHR 7.23.3 and 7.24.2, 2026-09-04. The find expression must be written [find where !dynamic ...]: a bare [find !dynamic ...] is a syntax error at the '!' on both releases (#924). MikroTik's Console manual writes it with 'where' too.

menus.usedFor: the optional push step -- storing the script that posts the router's own tables to mikroview
menus.verified: documented by MikroTik's CLI Reference, 2026-09-04. #1360's loaders and the push re-set were added, set and run on CHR 7.18.2, 7.22.3 and 7.24.4, 2026-10-01 (docs/routeros-verification-logs/<version>-blocklist.log), one console line each: before 7.19 a source pasted across several lines loses its line breaks.

menus.usedFor: the optional push step -- running that script on an interval; #1360's blocklist refresh schedules, each at its own start-time
menus.verified: documented by MikroTik's CLI Reference, 2026-09-04. #1360's schedules, with start-time, were added and re-set on CHR 7.18.2, 7.22.3 and 7.24.4, 2026-10-01 (docs/routeros-verification-logs/<version>-blocklist.log). days (7.24): with interval=0s it fires once on each listed day, checked on 7.24.4 by moving the clock; with interval=1d it works but carries RouterOS's own warning, and days="" means never, so leaving weekdays unsets days.

menus.usedFor: issue #1281 -- step 2's enrolment line, a one-shot informational log entry carrying the enrolment token the listener gate matches
menus.verified: documented by MikroTik's CLI Reference, 2026-09-19. Not yet exercised on a real CHR.

menus.usedFor: the push step -- the address-list block (leaving out mv-bl-*) and #1360's address-list-count block (print count-only, get creation-time); #1360's blocklist loaders
menus.verified: run on CHR 7.18.2 and 7.24.4, 2026-10-01, by #1360's push blocks (docs/routeros-verification-logs/<version>-push-blocklist.log). print as-value where !(list~"^mv-bl-") filters as written; set list= on a swap keeps each entry's creation-time. #1360's loaders added, renamed (set list=) and removed entries on CHR 7.18.2, 7.22.3 and 7.24.4, 2026-10-01 (docs/routeros-verification-logs/<version>-blocklist.log).

menus.usedFor: #1360's address-list-count block, and the Spamhaus IPv6 loader's mv-bl-spamhaus6
menus.verified: run on CHR 7.18.2 and 7.24.4, 2026-10-01, by #1360's push blocks (docs/routeros-verification-logs/<version>-push-blocklist.log). The Spamhaus IPv6 loader filled mv-bl-spamhaus6 on 7.18.2, 7.22.3 and 7.24.4 (docs/routeros-verification-logs/<version>-blocklist.log).

menus.usedFor: #1360's raw-rule push block; the blocklist builder's drop rules (raw prerouting, placed first)
menus.verified: run on CHR 7.18.2 and 7.24.4, 2026-10-01, by #1360's push blocks (docs/routeros-verification-logs/<version>-push-blocklist.log). print as-value carries no packets or bytes on either release, and no disabled on 7.18.2, so the block reads those three with get by .id. place-before=0 on an empty raw table is refused with 'no such item' on both, so the builder's rules add without it there; both branches, and the set branch's disabled=no, ran on 7.18.2, 7.22.3 and 7.24.4 (docs/routeros-verification-logs/<version>-blocklist.log).

menus.usedFor: #1360's raw-rule push block; the Spamhaus IPv6 drop rules
menus.verified: run on CHR 7.18.2 and 7.24.4, 2026-10-01, by #1360's push blocks (docs/routeros-verification-logs/<version>-push-blocklist.log), the same as ip/firewall/raw. The Spamhaus IPv6 rule went into an empty IPv6 raw table on 7.18.2, 7.22.3 and 7.24.4 (docs/routeros-verification-logs/<version>-blocklist.log).

menus.usedFor: #1360's blocklist loaders -- reading a fetched list in 32 KiB chunks, and removing it after a load
menus.verified: #1360's loaders read each fetched list with /file read (chunk-size tops out at 32768) and removed it, on CHR 7.18.2, 7.22.3 and 7.24.4, 2026-10-01 (docs/routeros-verification-logs/<version>-blocklist.log).
